newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM-Kymmene to up sack, kraft paper output.
newsitem.headline: UPM-Kymmene to up sack, kraft paper output.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would invest 200 million markka to increase output of sack and kraft paper at its Pietarsaari mill in north-western Finland.
"The production capacity will increase by 25,000 tonnes," UPM-Kymmene said, adding current annual output capacity of the machine to be rebuilt was about 135,000 tonnes.

The machine produces high-quality sack and kraft paper and the investment "will enhance the technical possibilities of the machine to prodce even higher quality sack and kraft paper grades," UPM-Kymmene said.
